maria (Partnerships): Quick ask — we need quantified supply curves from our hardware partners for the Q3 cost model (Zenith, VoltCloud, CoreWeave). Specifically: reserved commit sizing + price, spot floor & mean, preempt rates, burst/elastic pool behavior, lead times, and any marketplace/listing kickers. Need by EOD Thu if possible.

raj (Cost Modeling): Can you confirm the schema you want? hourly prices vs monthly, and do you want per-region rows?

maria (Partnerships): Per-region + SKU rows is ideal. Hourly price for the model (we convert to monthly as needed). Also include commit tenor (months), invoice lag, and any blackout windows. Example header below.

maria (Partnerships): ```csv
partner,region,sku_id,reserved_commit_qty,reserved_price_per_hr,commit_tenor_months,spot_floor_per_hr,spot_mean_per_hr,preempt_rate_pct,lead_time_days,burstable_pool_pct,invoice_lag_days,marketplace_listing_fee_pct,allowed_burst_hrs_per_month
```

raj (Cost Modeling): Perfect. Also pls include an empirical preempt distribution if you have it (eg hourly eviction prob or p(evict within 24h)). We use that to simulate fallback to backup models.

alex (Finance): One more: if you offer commit rebates or ladder discounts for >X months or >Y GPUs, please include the breakpoints and effective blended price.

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): Thanks — we can provide for Zenith and VoltCloud now, CoreWeave needs a little more ops time. Quick FYI on fields: marketplace_listing_fee_pct is our marketplace/portal take (if applicable). burstable_pool_pct is percent of reserved pool allowed to burst beyond commit (billed at spot).

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): Zenith, us-east-1, ZEN-RTXA-32, 1200, 0.28, 12, 0.08, 0.11, 2.1, 14, 8, 30, 4.5, 40

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): VoltCloud, us-west-2, VLT-A100-40, 800, 0.33, 6, 0.09, 0.13, 3.6, 21, 12, 45, 5.0, 60

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): Notes:
- preempt_rate_pct is long-run average percent of spot hours preempted per 30-day window (roughly).
- Allowed_burst_hrs_per_month is a soft cap we track for billing reconciliation.
- lead_time_days is typical lead time for guaranteed reserved start date after PO.

raj (Cost Modeling): Those numbers are great, thanks. For the preempt curve can you share the hourly survival curve? e.g.: p(survive t hours) = [0h:1.0,1h:0.998,6h:0.985,24h:0.92] or similar.

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): Quick survival samples from our telemetry (Zenith, last 60d): 0h:1.0,1h:0.9992,6h:0.996,12h:0.989,24h:0.965,72h:0.88. VoltCloud: 0h:1.0,1h:0.9986,6h:0.994,12h:0.986,24h:0.94,72h:0.82.

alex (Finance): Good to have. One question on fees: marketplace_listing_fee_pct here — is that additive to the partner price or taken from payout? How should we model margin impact?

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): Listing fee is charged to customer on top of partner price in our marketplace flow. For our payout calculation we pass through price minus platform fee. For cost model assume customer sees price*(1 + listing_fee_pct/100) as the billable. Our payout to partner = price*(1 - listing_fee_pct/100) except when partner opts into rebate windows (we'll provide entries for those).

maria (Partnerships): If CoreWeave can get their csv to us tomorrow morning that works. Raj/Alex — any other fields you want?

raj (Cost Modeling): Add a field 'eviction_latency_ms' if you have median eviction notification latency — helps for checkpointing cost.

 sophia (HW Partner Ops): Will add eviction_latency_ms. For Zenith median notification ~ 120s, VoltCloud ~ 90s.

maria (Partnerships): Awesome. Sophia — can you drop the CSVs in the partnerships drive folder and @raj when done?

 deploy-bot: uploaded a file: "partners_supply_q3/zenith_voltcloud_supply.csv" (size 23KB)

raj (Cost Modeling): Got it, pulling in now. Thanks everyone — we'll kick the sensitivity sims once CoreWeave arrives. :thumbsup:
